minutes.headline: Capital Planning Committee compared project rankings, agreed Flat Hill drainage and Senior Center parking lack data; final ranking set for Dec 14.
minutes.summary: Members compared their preliminary priority scores for FY23 capital requests, project by project. They agreed the Flat Hill Road drainage and Senior Center (Eagle House) parking projects lack enough information to be rated. Members will revise scores, and the chair will compile a composite list for a final meeting on December 14.

public_comment.topic: Chair of the school committee thanked the committee for considering school safety items in the capital plan, including the window safety film, and urged careful consideration of all of them.

what_happened.line: The Capital Planning Committee agreed to leave the Flat Hill Road drainage and Senior Center parking projects unrated because there is not enough information.
The town manager agreed there is not enough information on Flat Hill Road, so it stays unrated until the next meeting.
The chair will compile all members' preliminary scores into a composite priority list, with revisions due by Monday.
The next meeting is set for Wednesday, December 14, to finalize the prioritization, with a short January meeting expected.
A member said ARPA money and a special purpose stabilization account could pay for the ambulance now, outside the capital plan, given long lead times.

why_it_matters: The ranking sets which FY23 capital requests, such as vehicles, building work and school safety items, are put forward first, and those requests may come to residents as warrant articles.
Funding the ambulance from ARPA or a stabilization account instead of the capital plan would change what else the plan can pay for, and that proposal was to be raised at the Select Board.
watch_next: Final prioritization meeting on Wednesday, December 14, with the composite priority list compiled from members' revised scores.
A short January meeting, expected by the committee, and the committee's brief capital report in the warrant.
